SELECT STATUS FROM TASKS WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DOC_CHECK WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND NAME_KEY = #{nameKey}
DELETE FROM DOC_CHECK_HIT WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND NAME_KEY = #{nameKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOC_CHECK (TASK_ID, NAME_KEY, FILE_SHA256, FILE_SIZE, FILE_MTIME_MS, INSTITUTION_ID, STATE_CD, REASON_CD, HAS_IMAGES, HAS_EMBEDDED, ORDER_APPROX, HIT_ROWS, CHECKER_VER, CHECKED_AT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{nameKey}, #{fileSha256}, #{fileSize}, #{fileMtimeMs}, #{institutionId}, #{stateCd}, #{reasonCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{hasImages}, #{hasEmbedded}, #{orderApprox}, #{hitRows}, #{checkerVer}, #{checkedAt})
INSERT INTO DOC_CHECK_HIT (TASK_ID, NAME_KEY, FOUND_INST_ID, LOC_KIND, LOC_NO, HIT_COUNT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{nameKey}, #{foundInstId}, #{locKind}, #{locNo}, #{hitCount})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SEQ_NO), 0) FROM DOC_CHECK_LOG WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOC_CHECK_LOG (TASK_ID, SEQ_NO, EVENT_CD, NAME_KEY, FILE_SHA256, FOUND_INST_ID, LOC_KIND, LOC_NO, OPEN_COUNT, NOT_CHECKED_COUNT, PARTIAL_COUNT, EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, ACTED_AT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{seqNo}, #{eventCd}, #{nameKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileSha256,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{foundInstId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locKind,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{openCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{notCheckedCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{partialCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{empNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empVerified}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{actedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT L.SEQ_NO, L.EVENT_CD, L.FILE_SHA256, L.FOUND_INST_ID, L.LOC_KIND, L.LOC_NO, L.EMP_NO, U.NAME AS EMP_NAME, L.ACTED_AT FROM DOC_CHECK_LOG L LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.EMP_NO = L.EMP_NO WHERE L.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND L.EVENT_CD IN ('ACK', 'UNACK') ORDER BY L.SEQ_NO
